L4-0771.note: Idiom, no official POS. Kept the descriptive gloss; "every color under the sun" is CEDICT's flourish, not shorter or clearer.

L4-0772.note: V/N. Bare "to misunderstand" is 误解 (L5); 误会 is the everyday word, so it gets the everyday phrasing.

L4-0774.note: V. Not "to breathe" (呼吸 L4) and not "to absorb" (吸收 L4) — 吸 is the drawing-in action itself.

L4-0775.note: N. "pipette"/"snorkel" are lab and diving senses a learner will not meet at L4.

L4-0776.note: V. "to recruit" (吸收会员) is an institutional sense; dropped.

L4-0778.note: V. CEDICT's clause pile trimmed to the one sense that matters at L4.

L4-0779.note: V. Bare "to like" is 喜欢 (L1) and "to be fond of" is 爱好 (L1); 喜爱 is the stronger, more written liking.

L4-0782.note: Adj. "thin" is already 薄 (L4) and 瘦 (L5); 细 is thin in diameter — a thread, a waist, a line.

L4-0783.note: N. "particulars" adds nothing a learner needs.

L4-0784.note: Adj. Distinguished from 细 (slender) and 仔细 (careful): 细致 is care taken to a fine level of detail.

L4-0786.note: V. Not "to drop" (掉 L2) or "to lower" (降低 L4) — 下降 is the intransitive fall of a number or level.

L4-0790.note: Adj. "fresh" alone belongs to 新鲜 (L4). Standalone 鲜 (汤很鲜) is the savory-delicious sense; the fresh sense survives as meaning 2.

L4-0792.note: Adj. "vivid" is 生动 (L3). 鲜明 covers bright color and sharp contrast alike.

L4-0793.note: Adj. "stingy" is a dialect extension; excluded.

L4-0795.note: N. Dropped "(Japan) prefecture" — a country-specific note, not the Chinese administrative unit a learner needs.

L4-0796.note: V/N in that official order, so the verb leads and the noun follows.

meanings: to get along with each other
L4-0797.note: V. CEDICT's "to be in contact (with sb)" reads like radio contact; 相处 is how two people get on.

L4-0798.note: Adj/Conj. Bare "opposite" is 对面 (L2, spatial) and "contrary" is 反 (L4); meaning 2 carries the Conj use (相反，…).

L4-0799.note: M row, so the measure-word function leads. 盒 (L5) already owns small boxes; 箱 counts the big ones — 一箱苹果.

L4-0800.note: N. The everyday 箱子 a learner packs, not the generic "case".

L4-0801.note: V. Objects are people, so the gloss says so.

L4-0802.note: N/V officially; the L4 encounter is verbal (你能想象吗) and V is on the row, so a verb gloss may lead. Bare "to imagine" is 设想 (L5).

L4-0803.note: M row. Rewritten from "items, projects" — the UI joins meanings with a comma, so an internal comma reads as a second sense.

L4-0806.note: V. The "(fig.) to absorb information" clause is a figurative extension and is excluded.

L4-0808.note: N. Bare "snack" is 零食 (L4); 小吃 is the small cooked dish sold at a stall.

L4-0809.note: N. Distinct from 青年 "youth" (L2), which is the age bracket rather than the person.

L4-0812.note: M row quantifying a small number. Bare "some" is 一些 (L1) and "few" is 少 (L1), so 些 keeps both halves.

L4-0813.note: N. Both senses are live at L4 (心理学 / 他的心理).

L4-0817.note: Adj row, so the gloss is adjectival rather than the noun phrase "new type".

L4-0818.note: Adj row: CEDICT's noun "excitement" and its physiology sense cannot lead an Adj card.

L4-0820.note: N. Bare "circumstances" is 情况 (L3); 形势 is the big picture — economic, political, competitive.

L4-0821.note: N. 类型 (L4) owns bare "type", so 型 names the model/version sense it carries in 新型, 血型, 型号.

L4-0823.note: V. "to sober up" is a narrow extension; dropped.

L4-0826.note: N. Excluded CEDICT's humble first-person "I, me" sense — men's public-speech register, not learner material.

L4-0828.note: V. 补 (L3) currently leads with "to repair", so 修理 takes "to fix". CEDICT's "(coll.) to sort sb out" is excluded.

L4-0829.note: V/N. Bare "to choose"/"to select" are 选 (L2) and 挑选 (L4); 选择 is the act of settling on one.

L4-0835.note: V. 找 (L1) is the everyday "to look for"; 寻找 is the deliberate, sustained search.

L4-0837.note: N. "ivory" is 象牙 in practice; dropped.

meanings: adds a soft or surprised tone
L4-0840.note: Aux particle. Described by function rather than labelled; 啊 (L2) is glossed as the exclamation, 呀 as its post-vowel softener.

L4-0841.note: V. "to extend" is taken three times over (推广 L3, 扩展 L4, 延伸 L5); 延长 is specifically making something longer in time or length.

L4-0842.note: Separable 延∥期, no official POS. "to postpone" is 推迟 (L4); 延期 is specifically moving a scheduled date later.

L4-0843.note: V. "to continue" is 继续 (L3); 延续 is a tradition or state persisting over time.

L4-0844.note: Adj. 严格 (L4) holds bare "strict", so 严 leads with the person-facing "stern" (对孩子很严). "father" is a classical usage; dropped.

L4-0845.note: Adj/V. CEDICT's comma-pile trimmed; "tight" belongs to 严.

L4-0846.note: Adj. Of problems and illnesses. 认真 is "conscientious" and 严肃 "solemn", so "serious" is free here.

L4-0847.note: V row, so the noun "research" cannot lead. 查 (L2) currently ships "to research", so 研究 takes the fuller phrasing.

L4-0849.note: V. 研制新药 — research plus production, distinct from 开发 (L3).

L4-0852.note: N. The everyday word; 泪水 L4-0465 takes "flowing tears".

L4-0853.note: N phrase; the point is figurative regard (在他眼里), so the gloss states it plainly.

L4-0854.note: V. "to make a speech" is 发言 (L3) and "a speech" is 讲话 (L2); 演讲 is the prepared public address.

L4-0857.note: N. Dropped the animal-kidney food sense and the metonymic money-pouch sense — both register-wrong for a beginner.

L4-0858.note: V. 摇头, 摇船. "to crank" is a machine sense; dropped.

L4-0859.note: N. 药 (L2) is "medicine"; 药物 is the formal collective — what a doctor or label calls it.

L4-0860.note: Conj row — 要 as short for 要是, not the L1 verb "to want". 假如 L4-0375 keeps "supposing that".

L4-0861.note: Adj. 业余爱好 / 业余时间. "outside working hours" says the same thing longer.

L4-0862.note: N. CEDICT's second sense is drug slang and is excluded outright.

L4-0863.note: Official POS is V, so a bare noun "medical treatment" cannot lead. 治疗 (L4) is "to treat" an illness; 医疗 is care as a service (医疗保险).

L4-0864.note: N. Kept separate from 医疗 by naming the field rather than the service.

L4-0865.note: V/N. 靠 (L2) is the physical "to lean on"; 依靠 is the abstract reliance.

L4-0866.note: Adv. Bare "still" is 仍然 (L3) and "as before" is 依旧 (L5); 依然 keeps both halves so the three stay distinguishable.

L4-0867.note: Adv. "same; identical" is the adjectival half of the CEDICT entry and cannot lead an Adv row.

L4-0868.note: Adv. "repeatedly" is 反复 (L3), so 一再 leads with the idiomatic English equivalent.

L4-0869.note: Adj/Adv. 意见一致 — people agreeing, or two things matching.

L4-0870.note: V. 搬 (L3) is bare "to move" (furniture, house); 移 is nudging something to a different spot.

L4-0872.note: V/N. Chinese 移民 covers both directions, so the gloss avoids picking "immigrate" or "emigrate".

L4-0873.note: N. Both senses are live at L4 (遗产继承 / 世界文化遗产). 继承 (L5) is the verb, so the noun is free here.

L4-0874.note: V row, so the noun "heredity" cannot lead; "to inherit" is 继承 (L5) and means property, not genes.

L4-0875.note: N. Bare "question" is 问题 (L2) and "to doubt" is 怀疑 (L4); 疑问 is the doubt itself (毫无疑问).

L4-0879.note: N. CEDICT's "volunteer" is the attributive 义务 of 义务劳动 and misleads as a bare noun. 责任 (L3) is "responsibility".

L4-0880.note: V/N. "to discuss" is 讨论 (L2) and "to comment on" is 评论 (L5); 议论 is public talk about a person or event.

L4-0881.note: V. Single character behind 引起/引导/吸引. "to pull" is 拉 (L2); the classical bow-drawing and length-unit senses are dropped.

L4-0882.note: V. CEDICT's "to boot" is a computing sense and "primer" a noun; both excluded.

L4-0884.note: V. 引起注意/误会. 导致 (L4) is "to lead to" and 造成 (L3) "to bring about", so this phrasing keeps the three apart.

L4-0885.note: V (yīng). 应该 and 该 are L2, so "ought to" is free here; meaning 2 is the 应允 sense. Legal sense dropped.

L4-0886.note: Adj. Deliberately not "brave" — that is 勇敢 (L4), the everyday word.

L4-0889.note: N. The "(fig.) hint, influence" senses are excluded.

L4-0890.note: Adj. The plain word, kept plain.

L4-0892.note: N. Bare "use" collides with 用 (L1), 使用 (L2) and 应用 (L3); the plain-English phrasing is unambiguous and cannot be mistaken for a verb.

L4-0893.note: Adj. 优秀 (L4) is "outstanding" of people; 优良 describes quality, breeds, traditions.

L4-0897.note: Separable 有∥劲儿, no CEDICT entry. Colloquial "that's fun" sense omitted as spoken-register.

L4-0898.note: Adj. "interesting" is 有意思 (L2) and 可乐 (L3) holds "amusing"; 有趣 is what makes you smile.

L4-0901.note: Conj. "thereupon" is bookish; 所以 (L2) is "therefore" and 因此 (L3) "thus", so "and so" keeps 于是 distinct and readable.

L4-0903.note: N. The Internet "voice chat/voice message" senses are excluded as modern-app jargon.

L4-0908.note: V, bound form. 遇到 and 遇见 (both L4) take "to run into" and "to meet by chance"; 遇 keeps the formal head word. CEDICT's "to treat, to receive" (待遇) is the other morpheme sense and is dropped.

L4-0913.note: Adj/N in that official order, so the adjective leads. The currency sense (圆 = yuan) and the "tactful" sense are dropped.

L4-0914.note: Adj. 圆满成功/圆满结束 — everything ended as it should. "perfect" is 完美 (L3).

L4-0915.note: V/N. 约 (L3) already means "to make an appointment", so 约会 takes the romantic sense it usually carries.

L4-0921.note: V. "to use" is 用 (L1) and 使用 (L2); "to put to use" is 应用 (L3). 运用 is skill or knowledge brought to bear.

L4-0922.note: Adv. Kept distinct from 一再 "time and again" and 反复 "repeatedly"; 再三 carries the note of insistence (再三强调).

L4-0925.note: V. 同意 (L3) is "to agree"; 赞成 is backing a proposal. The literary "to assist" sense is dropped.

L4-0926.note: V. 表扬 (L4) is "to commend" (a superior praising) and 欣赏 (L5) "to appreciate"; 赞赏 is warm admiration expressed.

L4-0928.note: N row, so CEDICT's leading verb "to model" cannot lead. 形状 (L3) is plain "shape"; 造型 is the designed form (发型造型, 人物造型).

L4-0929.note: V/N. Distinguished from 打架 (L5) "to fight" — 战斗 is military.

L4-0930.note: V. 打败 (L4) is "to defeat"; 战胜 also takes abstract objects (战胜困难), which "to triumph over" carries.

L4-0931.note: N. 士兵 (L4) is bare "soldier" (the rank); 战士 is the fighter, and is used figuratively of anyone in a struggle.

L4-0934.note: V. 打招呼. 问候 (L4) is "to send one's regards"; 招呼 is the spoken hello.

meanings: used after a verb to show success
L4-0935.note: V (zháo), not the 着 zhe particle. Meaning 2 states the function a learner actually meets it in (睡着, 找着). Excluded the colloquial "to fall asleep" gloss, which belongs to 睡着 as a whole.

L4-0937.note: Separable 着∥急. 担心 (L4) is "worried"; 着急 is the impatient anxiety of waiting. The Taiwan pronunciation note is not learner copy.

L4-0938.note: V. The object is always a meeting or conference, so the gloss names it.

L4-0939.note: V. 断 (L3) leads with "to snap". The discount sense (打折) is a noun usage on this character and is left off a V row; the theatrical-scene classifier and "accounts book" senses are dropped.

L4-0940.note: N. 打针 makes the injection sense common at L4, so it stays as meaning 2.

L4-0941.note: V. 针对性/针对问题. CEDICT's four-clause pile trimmed to two.

meanings: a spell of wind or rain
L4-0942.note: M row, so the measure-word function leads: 一阵风, 一阵雨, 一阵笑声. "disposition of troops" is the classical sense; dropped.

L4-0943.note: V/N. 辩论 (L4) is "to argue over" (formal debate) and 争议 (L5) "to dispute"; 争论 is two sides going at an issue.

L4-0944.note: V. 克服 (L3) currently ships "to conquer" for difficulties, so 征服 names the military act it actually is.

L4-0945.note: V. 征求意见 is the fixed collocation; bare "to seek" would collide with 寻找.

L4-0948.note: N (positional). Bare "after" is 以后 (L2); 之后 attaches to what precedes it (三天之后).

L4-0949.note: N (positional). The bisyllabic-time-expression note in CEDICT is grammar trivia, not a sense.

L4-0951.note: Bound pattern …之一. Described by what it does rather than left as the fragment "one of".
